notes: The Roblox course is complete: six units from your first Luau script to shipping a real game, plus a final exam and a Roblox game developer certification
New "Game systems" unit: client and server, RemoteEvents, never trusting the client, data stores, tweens, object-oriented Luau, types, user interfaces and tools
New "Game-development techniques" unit: ray casting, spatial queries, state machines and NPC AI, pathfinding, procedural generation, game loops, cleanup, networking and inventories
New "Shipping games" unit: Rojo, testing, monetisation done right, data migrations, live operations, performance, publishing, and how Roblox compares to other engines
Four capstone games built from everything in the course: an obby with checkpoints, a tycoon with upgrades, a round-based arena, and a tower defence with waves and targeting
Every Roblox exercise runs in the built-in simulated Roblox engine, with tests proven to reject common wrong answers
